# MEICARE Pull Request

## What changed?
Describe the user/business problem and the exact change.

## Workstream
- [ ] Product / UX
- [ ] Engineering
- [ ] Clinical / Pharmacy workflow
- [ ] Security / Privacy
- [ ] Integration / VNPT-HIS
- [ ] IoT
- [ ] Operations

## Risk classification
- [ ] Low — no production data, security, clinical, contractual or financial impact
- [ ] Medium — limited operational impact, reversible
- [ ] High — production, tenant isolation, permissions, ingestion, IoT alerting or material workflow impact
- [ ] Critical — clinical safety, security boundary, destructive data change or unrecoverable impact

## Validation evidence
- [ ] Acceptance criteria documented
- [ ] Automated tests updated/passed where applicable
- [ ] Manual regression performed where applicable
- [ ] Migration/rollback path documented if data/schema changes
- [ ] Evidence linked in issue/PR

## Human approval gates
- [ ] No special gate required
- [ ] Founder A — Technology/Security approval required
- [ ] Founder B — Clinical Safety approval required
- [ ] Both founders — Reserved Matter / material cross-domain decision

## Production readiness
- [ ] No destructive operation
- [ ] Tenant isolation verified
- [ ] Observability/logging impact reviewed
- [ ] Rollback plan available
- [ ] Clinical-impacting behavior validated before release

## AI review notes
AI may draft tests, review code, identify risks and prepare evidence. AI must not independently approve clinical safety, material security changes, destructive production operations, pricing/contracts, or reserved matters.
